1052314.ov: Two unemployed young boys arrive at a railway track for committing suicide. They become friends but unfortunately are arrested by police who are trying to pin them for some unsolved crime cases. So they escape from the police station and reach a remote village where they find an aim in life. What is their aim?

1063706.ov: A village lad goes to the city where he finds the love of his life. Circumstances lead him to work as a DJ but eventually lands in jail. When the situation finally gets under his control, he realizes he is just a mere pawn of a politician.

1193754.ov: Minda Lalari, owner of a cloth dying shop, assists victims who have been neglected by law enforcement and ensures justice for them.

1457306.ov: Complications arise when a man with two wives attempts to get married a third time.

1741722.ov: In a dystopian world where memories are stored on external drives, a 65 year old man tries desperately to hold on to memories he no longer has space for.
